nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Closed-loop systems|Resource sharing networks_qna_000
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How can the development of intelligent networks among businesses help make a local FSC more competitive on the global market?
nodes.answer: The development of intelligent networks among businesses can help make a local FSC more competitive on the global market by allowing businesses to share their resources, thereby enhancing efficiency and productivity.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Closed-loop systems|Resource sharing networks_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the significance of developing intelligent networks for businesses in the context of sustainable production and consumption?
nodes.answer: Developing intelligent networks where businesses share resources can make local FSCs more competitive on the global market by facilitating growth and efficiency.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Closed-loop systems|Resource sharing networks_qna_002
nodes.question: How can product utilization be maximized through pool sharing?
nodes.answer: Product utilization can be maximized through pool sharing by allowing individuals or businesses to share resources or products, reducing the need for individual ownership and promoting a more sustainable approach to consumption.
